content: This document conveys the requirements for the vehicle telemetry interface between the Mobius® autonomous fleet management system and the customer's fleet vehicles. It is an *example instance* used to exercise every field of the requirements-document template: metadata autopopulation, header and footer composition, page numbering, the requirements table, and per-requirement detail.

requirements.statement: The vehicle shall report position at a rate of no less than 10 Hz while in autonomous operation.
requirements.rationale: Downstream path-tracking consumers assume a 100 ms position budget.
requirements.notes: Rate may degrade to 1 Hz in manual mode.

requirements.statement: The telemetry link shall deliver safety-state transitions to the operator console within 200 ms end to end.
The interface shall expose battery state of charge as a percentage with a resolution of 1% or finer.
The telemetry payload should remain parseable by consumers one major version behind the current schema.
requirements.rationale: Customers upgrade consoles on a slower cadence than vehicles.

requirements.statement: The interface may provide an operator-configurable reporting profile for bandwidth-constrained sites.
